It does not sell models: you connect the ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Grok, Cursor, Copilot or DeepSeek plan you already pay for, or your own API key, and each bot gets one job, one chat window and a memory you can read and edit. Bots sign in to sites and click through them on their own computer — a browser plus a desktop — which you can watch live and take the mouse back from at any time. Start with one bot and hire more as the work grows; several bots can sit in one group thread and hand work to each other, asking you before risky steps. Say a recurring job once and it becomes a routine (summarise the inbox at 8 every weekday, compare competitor prices on Mondays) that runs on a schedule or when something happens, even while you sleep. Official pricing: Free is $0 forever with every app feature, running on your own computer, no card, no account and no trial timer, but stops when the computer sleeps and has no work licence; Plus $20/mo moves bots to dusk cloud (2 vCPU, 4 GB RAM, 20 GB disk, always available); Pro $50/mo adds a bigger machine and a work licence for one person; Team $119/mo for 2 seats.

优惠内容What you get
Hark 是 Brett Adcock 创立的 Hark Labs 于 2026-10-06 推出的个人 AI 代理，定位「生活操作系统」：事情都在同一条长期对话里完成，另有按主题分线的 Projects 和可自定义的 Home。核心是 Handoff——每个请求都会开一台独立云端虚拟电脑，带自己的浏览器、文件系统与终端，能像人一样登录上百万个网站、下单、退订、填表、报销、订位、做幻灯片；官方称它可同时处理 6 个浏览器，浏览器之外还通过 API 直连 Google Workspace 与 Microsoft 365，可读文件、查外部数据库、走 MCP。配合 Memory 记住你的偏好与上下文，以及 Action Buttons（一键付账单/退订）、Panels（一句话生成 Mini App）、Scheduled Tasks 与 Specialties（把多步流程记成固定套路）。价格：Hark Pro 全功能永久免费、无广告，只受基础用量上限约束（官方未公布具体数值）；Pro² $20/月为 2× 用量，Pro³ $100/月为 10× 用量，所有档位功能完全一致，只有用量差别；美国 App Store 另有 Pro⁴（$259.99，10× Pro²，2026-11-11 上线），且应用内购价高于官网。安全方面，密码与卡号放在连 Hark 自己都看不到的加密保险库 Secured by Hark，付款、下单等敏感动作会先向你确认；官方承诺不出售数据、不向广告商共享。Hark is the personal AI agent Hark Labs, founded by Brett Adcock, launched on 2026-10-06, positioned as an operating system for your life: everything happens in one long-running chat, with topic threads called Projects and a customisable Home. At its centre is Handoff — every request spins up a dedicated virtual computer with its own browser, file system and terminal, which signs into millions of sites like a person, places orders, cancels subscriptions, fills forms, files expenses, books tables and makes slides. Hark says it can juggle six browsers at once; outside the browser it connects to Google Workspace and Microsoft 365 by API and can read files, query external databases and use MCP. Memory keeps your preferences and context, and Action Buttons (pay a bill or cancel in one tap), Panels (mini apps built from a sentence), Scheduled Tasks and Specialties (multi-step routines it memorises) do the rest. Pricing: the full Hark Pro feature set is free forever with no ads, limited only by a base usage cap whose size Hark has not published; Pro² at $20/mo gives 2x the usage and Pro³ at $100/mo gives 10x, with the same features in every plan. The US App Store also lists Pro⁴ ($259.99, 10x Pro², launched 2026-11-11), and its in-app prices run above the website's. Passwords and cards sit in Secured by Hark, an encrypted vault Hark itself cannot see inside, and it checks with you before payments or orders; Hark says it never sells your data or shares it with advertisers.

优惠内容What you get
Sesame（Sesame AI, Inc.，Oculus 联合创始团队创办）做的是语音优先的个人 AI，官网现有四个角色 Maya、Miles、Simone、Charlie，在 iOS / Android app 里直接打电话或发文字，登录后会记住与每个角色的过往对话。免费档 $0：每天 30 分钟通话时长（每日重置）与每周有限的 credits（文字、任务与更高智能档都用它，每周重置），所有功能各档一致；额度用完仍可文字聊天，但模型智能降低、部分能力受限。Plus $20/月为每天 2 小时（4×）与 4× 周 credits，Pro $100/月为每天 10 小时（20×），另有 1 小时 $5 / 5 小时 $20 的加时包、1,000 credits $5 / 5,000 credits $20 的加购包（一次性购买不过期、排在套餐额度之后使用），Plus 可免费试 7 天，订阅通过 App Store / Google Play 管理。Sesame Link（link.sesame.com）把终端里的编码 agent 接到手机上：在跑 Claude Code、Codex、Pi、Cursor、Hermes、OpenCode 的电脑上装一个 CLI 并登录同一个 Sesame 账号，就能用浏览器 web client，或直接给 Sesame 角色打电话，问「What are my sessions doing?」逐个听 session 状态、说「Focus on …」聚焦某个 session 与 Claude/Codex 实时对话、口头批准或拒绝权限请求、让它开新 session 或结束 session；代码、工具与账号始终留在你自己的电脑上，Link 只做云端中转。Sesame (Sesame AI, Inc., from the co-founders of Oculus) builds voice-first personal AI. Its site lists four characters — Maya, Miles, Simone and Charlie — you call or text in the iOS and Android app, and when signed in each remembers its past conversations with you. The free plan is $0: 30 minutes of talk time a day (resets daily) and limited weekly credits for texts, tasks and higher intelligence (resets weekly), with the same features on every plan. When the allowance runs out you can keep texting, but intelligence drops and some capabilities are restricted. Plus is $20/mo for 2 hours a day (4x) and 4x the weekly credits; Pro is $100/mo for 10 hours a day (20x); add-ons are 1 hour of talk time for $5 or 5 hours for $20, and 1,000 credits for $5 or 5,000 for $20 (one-time purchases never expire and are used after the plan allowance). Plus has a free 7-day trial, and subscriptions are managed through the App Store or Google Play. Sesame Link (link.sesame.com) puts the coding agents in your terminal on your phone: install a CLI on the computer running Claude Code, Codex, Pi, Cursor, Hermes or OpenCode and sign in with the same Sesame account, then use the browser web client or simply call your Sesame character to ask "What are my sessions doing?" and hear each session's status, say "Focus on …" to talk to Claude or Codex live, approve or deny permission requests by voice, and start or end sessions. The code, tools and accounts stay on your own computer; Link only relays through Sesame's cloud.
参与条件Conditions
免费档无需绑卡；通话时长每天重置、credits 每周重置，通话用 talk time、任何「替你去办」的任务用 credits，Max 智能档两者同时消耗；额度用尽后仍可文字但能力受限；Sesame Link 需要 Sesame 账号，并在电脑上装 CLI、已安装并登录对应编码 agent（Claude Code 还需 tmux 3.4+，桌面版不算），只支持 macOS 与 x86-64 Linux（preview）；Claude Code 完整支持，Codex / Pi / Cursor 为 preview，Hermes / OpenCode 为 experimental；未上架地区只能用网页 Research Preview，功能比 app 少；官方仅正式支持英语，中法德西意日韩为早期支持、可靠性较低。No card is needed for the free plan. Talk time resets daily and credits weekly; calls use talk time and anything the agent goes and does uses credits, while Max intelligence uses both. When the allowance is gone you can still text, with lower intelligence and some restrictions. Sesame Link needs a Sesame account plus the CLI installed on a computer with the coding agent installed and signed in (Claude Code also needs tmux 3.4+; the desktop apps don't count), and runs on macOS and x86-64 Linux (preview) only. Claude Code is fully supported; Codex, Pi and Cursor are previews; Hermes and OpenCode are experimental. Where the app isn't listed you can only use the web Research Preview, which does less than the app. Sesame officially supports English, with early, less reliable support for Chinese, French, German, Spanish, Italian, Japanese and Korean.

Pickle 是能实际办事的个人 AI 代理，核心不是聊天，而是代你操作：① 云端浏览器代操作：官方帮助写明 Pickle 使用「真正的网页浏览器」，像人一样在网站上完成订位、买票、下单、退订、查银行/投资记录、在政府网站申请文件；这台浏览器在云端、和你的手机分开，遇到只有你能做的步骤（验证码、想自己输密码）可以把屏幕接过来自己点。② 直接替你打电话：没有预订页面的餐厅、诊所前台、房东、客服中心，Pickle 自己拨电话沟通，通话过程可实时旁听，结束后汇报结果，录音/记录留在菜单的 Other chats。③ 付款与预订前先给你看卡片（做什么、多少钱），你同意才执行；金额临时变高会再问一次。免费机制（日本帮助中心原文）：日本所有账号免费、没有付费计划，改用「1 日の利用上限」——每天 04:00（日本时间）重置为 0%。回复、Chat 通话、任务与排程任务都计入；3D World 通话中的对话与 Pickle 自己的固定例程不占额度。达到上限后输入框关闭、排程任务跳过，直到 04:00。重置券：全体重置券把当天用量归零，半分重置券降 50 点（不会低于 0%）。注册完成送 1 张全体券；每邀请一位朋友完成注册，你和对方各得 1 张全体券；也可在 app 内购买（价格见购买画面：美区 App Store 列全体券 $3.99、半分券 $1.99，日区约 ¥600/张，各地不同）。券不过期，只恢复当天额度、不提高每日上限。Pickle is a personal AI agent that actually does the work rather than only chatting. Two things define it. First, a cloud browser: the official help says Pickle uses a real web browser to work sites the way a person would — booking restaurants and flights, buying things, cancelling subscriptions, reading bank and brokerage records, requesting documents on government sites. That browser lives in the cloud, separate from your phone, and if a step only you can do comes up (a CAPTCHA, or you'd rather type your own password) the screen is handed to you to finish. Second, phone calls: for places with no booking page — a restaurant, a clinic's front desk, your landlord, a customer service line — Pickle calls for you, the call can be followed live, the result is reported back, and the record sits in Other chats. Before a payment or booking it shows a card of what it will do and at what price and waits for your go-ahead; if the amount rises right before paying, it asks again. Free plan (per the Japanese help centre): in Japan every account is free with no paid plan, replaced by a daily usage limit that resets to 0% at 04:00 Japan time. Replies, calls from Chat, handed-off tasks and scheduled tasks all count; conversations on 3D World calls and Pickle's own fixed routines do not. At the limit the input box turns off and scheduled tasks are skipped until 04:00. Reset tickets: a Full reset ticket returns the day's usage to 0%; a Half reset ticket lowers it by 50 points (never below 0%). You get one Full ticket for finishing onboarding, one each for you and each friend who completes sign-up through your invite link, and you can buy more in the app at prices shown on the purchase screen (the US App Store lists $3.99 for a Full ticket and $1.99 for a Half ticket; Japan about ¥600 each — it varies by store). Tickets don't expire and only restore the current day's usage; they don't raise the daily cap.

优惠内容What you get
Skrill Money Transfer 的 Refer a Friend 计划，官方条款里英国一栏写得很明确：注册国为 United Kingdom 的用户，最低汇款额 GBP 100（或等值发送币种），推荐额度 GBP 10，推荐人与新客双方各拿一份。流程是：新客通过邀请人的推荐链接注册账户，或在首笔汇款页点「Got a referral code?」填入推荐码（推荐码自注册起 3 个月内有效），完成一笔跨区汇款（汇款人与收款人分处不同国家、金额 ≥£100，不含手续费与税费、成功交付）后，Skrill 在确认收款方入账后把 £10 额度放进账户的 My Account → Refer a Friend 模块，可抵扣下一笔符合条件的汇款，3 个月内用掉，单笔最多抵 £50（最多叠 5 个额度）。账户注册与 KYC 需要证件 + 地址证明（护照 + 英国地址证明即可，官方给 4 天补齐，逾期交易取消）。付款方式为英国发行的借记卡/信用卡或英国银行账户，不能用 Skrill 余额付。同一账户里还能申请 Skrill Prepaid Mastercard：英国与 EEA 居民可申请，数字卡审批通过即可用，实体卡 15 个工作日内寄到，卡以欧元计价。用户英区实测：英国卡付款，汇往德国、美国、意大利、菲律宾的账户基本秒到，且全程在网页端操作（App 下单用不上这个优惠）。Skrill Money Transfer's Refer a Friend programme; the official terms state the UK line clearly: users registered in the United Kingdom, minimum transfer GBP 100 (or the equivalent in the send currency), referral credit GBP 10 for both the inviter and the new customer. The flow: the new customer registers through the inviter's link, or enters the code under "Got a referral code?" on the first transfer page (codes are valid for 3 months from registration), completes a cross-border transfer (sender and recipient in different countries, at least £100 excluding fees and taxes, delivered successfully), and once the recipient's funds are confirmed Skrill places £10 of credit under My Account → Refer a Friend, usable on the next qualifying transfer within 3 months, up to £50 per transfer (at most 5 credits). Registration and KYC need an ID plus proof of address (a passport plus UK proof of address is enough, with 4 days to supply it before the transaction is cancelled). Payment must be a UK-issued debit or credit card or a UK bank account — Skrill balance can't be used. The same account can apply for the Skrill Prepaid Mastercard: UK and EEA residents qualify, the virtual card works as soon as it's approved, the physical card arrives within 15 working days and it's denominated in euros. A UK user's hands-on report: paying with a UK card, transfers to Germany, the US, Italy and the Philippines arrived almost instantly, all done on the website (ordering in the app doesn't get this offer).

条款自相矛盾：3.4 写额度抵「下一笔」，3.6 与营销页又说新客「首笔即可用」，实际以下单页报价为准，按要再汇一笔 ≥£100 来规划；成本不为零——卡充值 1% + 换汇 3.99%（Skrill 自有汇率还有加点），两笔 £100 大约花 £7–8，净赚约 £5，本来就打算汇款才最划算；「秒到」「必须网页端别用 App」是用户实测 DP，官方只承诺数分钟到 2 个工作日；卡以欧元计价，€10 年费（部分用户另有 €10 开卡费）+ 1.75% ATM + 3.99% 换汇，只在真的要刷卡时值得开；KYC 的英国地址证明必须真实属于本人，借地址过审属合规风险，账户可能被冻结、余额难取回；账户 12 个月无交易按 €5/月收不活跃费；2027-02-01 起英国 Skrill 业务从 Skrill Limited 转到 Paysafe Financial Services Limited，条款会随之更新。The terms contradict themselves: 3.4 says the credit applies to "the next transfer" while 3.6 and the marketing page say new customers can use it on the first, so go by the quote at checkout and plan for a second £100+ transfer; it isn't free to run — 1% card top-up plus 3.99% FX (with Skrill's own rate mark-up) makes two £100 transfers cost about £7–8, leaving roughly £5, so it's only worth it if you meant to send money anyway; "instant" and "must use the website, not the app" are user data points, and the official promise is minutes to 2 business days; the card is euro-denominated with a €10 annual fee (some users also pay a €10 issuance fee), 1.75% at ATMs and 3.99% FX, so only open it if you'll really spend; the UK proof of address must genuinely be yours, since borrowing an address is a compliance risk that can freeze the account and make the balance hard to recover; accounts with no transactions for 12 months pay a €5/mo inactivity fee; from 2027-02-01 the UK Skrill business moves from Skrill Limited to Paysafe Financial Services Limited and the terms will change with it.

It supports deploy-on-push from GitHub, Docker images, direct directory uploads and a template marketplace (WordPress, Vaultwarden, Nginx Proxy Manager and more); each web app gets an xxx.cloady.io subdomain and TLS automatically, and there's a REST API, CLI, Terraform and MCP. The new terms apply to new accounts from 2026-11-02.
